source.basis: Actual original PNG pixels, opened once before any prior author spec, context, inventory, failure or render report was read.

subfigures.description: One unframed black-on-white plane-line diagram. Four finite straight strokes, two distinct crossing locations, four lowercase-looking line labels and one uppercase B-shaped junction label.

strokes.description: A rising diagonal from lower left near pixel (41,334) to upper right near (280,27). Its a-shaped label is just above/left of the upper endpoint. It crosses the descending stroke c at the upper-left crossing.
A steeper rising stroke from near the bottom edge (162,460) to near (313,56). Its b-shaped label is left of the upper endpoint. It passes through the lower shared junction with strokes c and p.
A descending diagonal from left near (14,211) to lower right near (250,395). Its c-shaped label is above its left end. It passes through both the upper-left crossing and the lower shared junction.

A rising diagonal from near (147,425) to right near (358,151). Its p-shaped label is to the right/below the upper-right endpoint. It passes through the lower shared junction and visually runs in the same direction as stroke a.

pointsAndRelationships.description: Unlettered intersection near (90,270) of strokes a and c. A tiny outlined square-like right-angle marker lies on its upper/right side. No distinct filled point symbol is visible.
Common crossing near (201,355) of strokes b, c and p. The uppercase B-shaped label lies below/right of the crossing, between lower stroke extensions. No separate filled point dot is visible.

Strokes a and p visibly have matching rising diagonal directions; c crosses both. The b stroke through the lower junction is steeper than either rising diagonal. This is a visual observation, not a new measured value or answer-key inference.

tinyMarks.description: Small outlined corner/square at the a/c crossing, approximately pixels 92-108 by 260-279. It appears to indicate a right angle between a and c. Individual thin-edge pixels are uncertain at this scan scale.

Small outlined corner/square at the lower junction, approximately pixels 205-219 by 346-364, on the right side between the upper-right p ray and the lower-right c ray. It appears to indicate a right angle between p and c; there is no visually separate b/c angle mark.

labels.placement: Below/right of the common junction, not at the upper-left crossing.

inventory.rowsColumnsAndGrids: None: no table, grid, axes, ticks, numeric values or rows/columns.
inventory.otherVisibleFeatures: No arrows, equal-length hatch marks, angle numerals, units, lengths, separate panels, caption or border. The original scan has italic-looking letterforms and minor raster irregularity; neither is new semantic content.
uncertainties: The scan establishes glyph shapes a, b, c, p and B, not their Unicode alphabet. The a/c/p/B shapes can be alphabetically ambiguous between Latin and Cyrillic. Preserve the source alphabet uncertainty; do not infer codepoints from shape.
The lowercase b-shaped glyph is recorded by appearance, not claimed as a definitive original letter codepoint.
Both tiny outlined marks look like right-angle markers, but their individual thin edges and exact source-pixel coordinates are not completely resolved. No finer source facts were invented.
